skill.description: Create FiftyOne datasets from local media directories, import common label formats, run model inference, and store predictions for review.

skill.author: AdonaiVera

security_audit.summary: The static findings are mostly false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, and documentation links. The skill is focused on FiftyOne dataset import and inference, but it includes behavior-level risks around Bash directory scans and dependency installation commands returned by tooling.

remediation.issue: Shell directory scanning examples use direct placeholder path substitution.
remediation.suggestion: Require path validation, quote all paths, prefer structured filesystem APIs, and avoid shell interpolation for user-provided paths.

remediation.issue: Dependency install commands may come from MCP or plugin responses.
remediation.suggestion: Show the exact command, explain the package source, require explicit user confirmation, and restrict installs to known package managers and packages.

semantic_findings.title: Unquoted User Path in Shell Examples
semantic_findings.description: The workflow tells the assistant to scan a user-provided directory with Bash examples that substitute the path directly. A path with shell metacharacters could be unsafe if copied into a shell command without quoting or structured arguments.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The Bash examples and user-provided path are explicit. The skill also asks for confirmation before dataset creation, so the risk depends on how the assistant executes the scan.

semantic_findings.title: Unverified Dependency Install Command
semantic_findings.description: The skill says model dependency failures include an install_command and tells the assistant to offer to run it. Running dependency commands returned by tooling without verification can install unexpected packages or execute shell commands.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The text explicitly references install_command and installation. It does not require automatic execution, so normal user approval may reduce impact.

content.value_statement: Computer vision teams need repeatable ways to load media, labels, and predictions into FiftyOne. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through dataset creation, import validation, and model inference.
actual_capabilities: Scans local directories to identify supported media and label files.
Creates persistent FiftyOne datasets through MCP operators.
Imports media-only datasets and labeled COCO, YOLO, VOC, CVAT, KITTI, and TF formats.
Runs built-in FiftyOne model zoo inference for detection, classification, segmentation, and embeddings.
Launches the FiftyOne App and filters views to inspect prediction fields.
Validates imported sample counts against the source directory.
limitations: Requires a running FiftyOne MCP server and the referenced Voxel51 plugins.
Only supports dataset types and model names available in the local FiftyOne environment.
Some models require extra packages, hardware resources, or longer processing time.
The skill does not evaluate model accuracy or tune model thresholds automatically.

use_cases.title: Prepare Image Review Sets
use_cases.description: Load unlabeled image folders into FiftyOne and generate detection predictions for visual review.

use_cases.title: Import Labeled Benchmarks
use_cases.description: Create datasets from COCO, YOLO, or VOC labels while keeping ground truth separate from predictions.

use_cases.title: Validate Client Data Drops
use_cases.description: Inspect folder contents, import samples, confirm counts, and open a FiftyOne view for quality checks.

prompt_templates.title: Import Media Folder
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner dataset creation from unlabeled files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a FiftyOne dataset from this local media folder. Inspect the folder first, propose a dataset name, and ask before importing.

prompt_templates.title: Import COCO Labels
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate import with ground truth annotations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Import my COCO image dataset into FiftyOne. Use a separate ground_truth field and validate the sample count after import.

prompt_templates.title: Run Fast Detection
prompt_templates.prompt: After the dataset is imported, run a fast built-in detection model and save predictions in a predictions field.

prompt_templates.title: Build Full Review Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced end-to-end dataset and inference flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an end-to-end FiftyOne workflow for this dataset. Detect the format, import labels, run a suitable model, launch the app, and summarize validation results.

output_examples.input: A folder of unlabeled product images needs object detection predictions.
output: Images imported from the selected directory.
Detection predictions saved in the predictions field.
FiftyOne view filtered to samples with predictions.

output_examples.input: A COCO annotation file and image directory need import validation.
output: COCO labels imported into the ground_truth field.
Imported sample count compared with the source file count.
FiftyOne App opened for visual inspection.

output_examples.input: A YOLOv5 dataset needs conversion into a searchable review dataset.
output: YOLOv5 directory imported as a FiftyOne dataset.
Ground truth labels stored separately from any predictions.
Dataset context set for follow-up analysis.

best_practices: Confirm dataset name, label fields, and source paths with the user before import.
Keep ground truth labels and model predictions in separate fields.
Start with smaller model variants before running slower or heavier models.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite existing datasets without explicit user approval.
Do not run dependency install commands without reviewing the exact command first.
Do not mix imported labels and predictions in the same field.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates FiftyOne datasets from local media and can add imported labels or model predictions.

faq.question: Which label formats are supported?
faq.answer: The instructions cover COCO, YOLO, VOC, KITTI, CVAT, TensorFlow records, and classification directory trees.

faq.question: Can it run model inference?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides the assistant to use FiftyOne Model Zoo operators for detection, classification, segmentation, or embeddings.

faq.question: Does it need a local setup?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires FiftyOne MCP and the referenced Voxel51 plugins to be installed and running.

faq.question: Will it ask before importing data?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to inspect the folder and confirm settings with the user before import.

faq.question: Can it evaluate model quality?
faq.answer: It can prepare datasets and predictions for review, but it does not define evaluation metrics or accuracy reports.
